Now celebrating 16 years at the Howlin Wolf.  It is the Premier comedy show in the city. Comedy Gumbeaux Comedy Gumbeaux is considered a pro/am show. Is divided into three segments. Then the pros take over this is where season vets, touring comics and some national and even international comedians hit the stage. The third and final segment is for our drop ins. Irvin Mayfield is a Billboard and two-time Grammy Award- winning artist, composer, and producer. His 30+ record discography and published written works keynote three decades of world-tours, recorded performances, and collaborations with distinguished artists such as Stevie Wonder, Bob Weir, Frank Ocean, Aaron Neville, Wynton Marsalis, and Trombone Shorty.

A humanist born, raised, and presently residing in New Orleans, LA, Mayfield espouses a daily practice of constant reimagination in his community. His upcoming recording and live performance projects engage global thought leadership edging on the frontiers of art, media, technology and beauty.

9PM

Now celebrating 16 years at the Howlin Wolf.  It is the Premier comedy show in the city. Comedy Gumbeaux Comedy Gumbeaux is considered a pro/am show. Is divided into three segments. Kermit Ruffins needs only two words to hype a New Orleans barroom for one of his weekly shows, and this, his personal slogan, sums up what this Big Easy ambassador is all about.
